text.name: Yanma

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

text.name: Spinarak

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

text.name: Ariados

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Poisonous Nest
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this Ability. Both Active Pokémon (except for {Grass} Pokémon) are now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Impound
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

text.name: Yanmega

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Sonic Vision
abilities.text: If you have exactly 4 cards in your hand, ignore all Energy in the attack cost of each of this Pokémon's attacks.

attacks.name: Assault Boom
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.

text.flavor: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

attacks.name: Barrier Break
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

rules.label: BREAK Evolution Rule
rules.text: Yanmega BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

text.name: Combee
text.flavor: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

text.name: Vespiquen

attacks.name: Intelligence Gathering
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Bee Revenge
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile.

text.flavor: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

text.name: Revitalizer
effect: Put 2 {Grass} Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Forest of Giant Plants
effect: Each player's {Grass} Pokémon can evolve during his or her first turn or the turn he or she plays those Pokémon.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Level Ball
effect: Search your deck for a Pokémon with 90 HP or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Sky Return
attacks.text: Return this Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Lysandre
effect: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon.

effect: Put 1 of your Pokémon into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.)

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Battle Compressor
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 cards and discard them. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
